topStory.headline: EdTech Magazine: IT Leaders Adopt Risk Frameworks for Campus A.I. Governance
topStory.summary:
Higher education IT leaders are implementing Continuous Threat Exposure Management approaches to A.I. governance, according to EdTech Magazine. The strategy helps institutions understand what A.I. systems exist in their environment, which ones matter most to their risk posture, and how to continuously reduce risk as new tools emerge.

The framework approach recognizes that A.I. tools are entering campuses through multiple channels: centrally procured platforms, departmental projects, faculty-led pilots, and unofficial student and staff adoption. ServiceNow's recent acquisitions of Armis and Veza are being positioned as components for creating integrated platforms where asset visibility and A.I. governance work together.

The approach emphasizes creating "walled gardens" for A.I. experimentation rather than blanket restrictions, reflecting an understanding of academic culture where universities thrive on innovation and exploration. The article suggests starting with A.I.-powered service desk and student support systems as high-impact applications where governance lessons can be applied elsewhere on campus. Implementation requires skilled personnel who can interpret data, make risk assessments, and maintain ongoing oversight.

stories.headline: University of Delaware Positions as A.I. Healthcare Hub
stories.summary: Computer science professor Weisong Shi guest-edited a special journal issue on A.I. in healthcare, highlighting Delaware's collaborative approach between universities, health systems, and government, according to Newswise. The state is emerging as a model for A.I.-enabled healthcare innovation.

stories.headline: Chicago Booth Partners with MasterClass on A.I. Business Education
stories.summary: The University of Chicago Booth School of Business launched MasterClass Executive, a 12-week A.I.-native certificate program developed with OpenAI, according to Chicago Booth. The program combines Booth faculty expertise with global business leaders to prepare professionals for A.I.-driven markets.
stories.source: University of Chicago Booth School of Business

stories.headline: UH Hilo Professor Named National A.I. Research Fellow
stories.summary: Winston Wu joins 25 national ambassadors in the NSF NAIRR A.I. Education Fellows program, according to the University of Hawaii System. The fellowship supports faculty in integrating A.I. resources into courses and advancing A.I. education through the NAIRR Pilot Classroom initiative.

stories.headline: Indian EdTech Leader Outlines A.I. Literacy Strategy
stories.summary: Navneet Education's Harshil Gala discusses preparing students for an A.I.-driven world, emphasizing teacher training, problem-solving over screen time, and parent engagement, according to ET Edge Insights. The company offers free A.I. tools to schools while partnering with IIT Gandhinagar on responsible A.I. usage.

stories.headline: Cal State Faculty Petition Against OpenAI Contract Renewal
stories.summary: Over 1,600 faculty, students, and alumni signed a petition opposing renewal of Cal State's $17 million ChatGPT Edu contract, according to Tech Policy Press. Critics argue the investment is financially irresponsible during budget cuts and question the educational value of generative A.I. tools.

stories.headline: Colorado Working Group Recommends Revisions to 2024 A.I. Law
stories.summary: A state working group released unanimous recommendations to revise Colorado's 2024 A.I. Act, focusing on disclosure requirements and shared liability between A.I. developers and deployers, according to StateScoop. The proposal aims to balance consumer protection with innovation concerns.
